body:
ICYMI – last week, we launched a few features on alpha.midjourney.com that we're really excited about: style previews in the sidebar so you can see what you’ll get before you generate, larger images in create, and setting default parameters in a folder. Mostly focused on bugs and cleanup this week, as we get ready to launch some new collaborative tools next week. As always, the goal is making the site easier to use without taking control away. A lot this week came from #alpha-ideas-and-bugs and office hours, so keep your thoughts coming!

WHAT YOU SAID Now, sending a previewed style keeps your prompt-bar settings. Prompt parameters are saved per folder, within a tab's session. If you have 100K+ images, opening one deep in your history used to crash the site. Not anymore! We made scrolling/using arrow keys to scroll through images on the lightbox a lot clearer and easier. Filters clear when you switch between Organize and Create. Mac right click on create feed images works the old way. You can do sidebar style previews with profiles too – images coming next.

PROMPT BAR & PILLS Mixing style references? All the srefs in your prompt now show as a single style pill with thumbnails, and hovering the pill will list the codes. You can also pin --exp as a default for a folder: click the advanced section of settings. By the way, we’re generating sample grids for more srefs every week.

SEARCH Searching now starts the Create and Explore feeds from the top, and Back restores the page you were on.

EDITING Edits now keep the base image's aspect ratio, so a stray --ar in your prompt won't stretch the result. Action rows in the edit view scroll when they don't fit your window.

CREATE FEED List view keeps the prompt where it belongs, cards no longer get peek out from within the header, and the "To top" control is a small pill that stays out of your way. On tablets the rerun button keeps its shape. Collapsed sidebar rows now have their "..." menu.

ORGANIZE & DRAG AND DROP The selection rectangle in Organize mode now starts from anywhere, so selecting no longer accidentally drags images. Dragging an image shows an attach card on the prompt bar with a "Reference style" option below it. Moodboard pages accept files dropped straight from your computer.

POLISH & BUGS If you encounter a dead button on the Plans page you’ll now see a clear explanation. Someone else's private moodboard code now says it's private instead of erroring. Older browsers get a friendly unsupported-browser notice instead of a crash. Images that fail to load now retry instead of leaving a blank tile.

UP NEXT Better ways to share and generate together, collaboratively. Persistent edit history. Better ways to explore, find, and create styles as we move towards what David calls “the aesthetic singularity.” 🕴️

Please keep the feedback coming in #alpha-ideas-and-bugs ! And, as always, thank you for being part of our community ❤️
